title: Mechanical dimension and current-version audit
scope: reSpeaker Flex core and array modules

outcome.method: Manufacturer-published dimensions and official firmware coordinates only; photographs were not used for measurement.

version_follow_up.finding: The official Wiki source was updated on 2026-08-07 and remains the current integration documentation inspected in this pass.
version_follow_up.compatibility_boundary: Flex documentation names XIAO ESP32S3. It does not certify the newer XIAO ESP32S3 Plus as a drop-in Flex host even though the published 21 x 17.8 mm envelope matches.

version_follow_up.finding: The current datasheet is release 7 dated 2026-03-17 and adds XVF3800-QF60B-I. Package dimensions remain QF60, 7 x 7 mm, 0.4 mm pitch.
The public hardware design archive remains version 1V1 dated 2023-06-28.
